en.t: Because of this, I grew wary again.

units.source_text: 但是，正如刚才说过的，我对小姐有着强烈的爱，

en.t: But, as I have just said, my love for the young lady was intense,

units.source_text: 对她的母亲怀有多少戒心，又能怎么样呢？

en.t: so what good would it do to be wary of her mother, no matter how much?

units.source_text: 我嘲笑自己，有时还骂自己愚蠢。

en.t: I laughed at myself, and at times even called myself a fool.

units.source_text: 然而，如果仅仅是这点矛盾的话，那么无论怎么骂自己愚蠢，我也不会感觉有多痛苦。

en.t: Yet if the contradiction had gone no further than that, I would not have suffered very much, however much I scolded myself for being foolish.

units.source_text: 我的苦恼在于，我又开始疑心小姐是否也和夫人一样，是个阴谋家。

en.t: My anguish lay in the fact that I began to suspect again whether the young lady, like her mother, might also be a schemer.

units.source_text: 一想到这一切有可能是她们母女二人暗地里合谋搞的，我便立刻痛苦难耐。

en.t: The moment I thought that all of this might have been secretly arranged by mother and daughter together, I was seized by unbearable pain.

units.source_text: 已经不是不愉快的问题了，而是如同坠入了万劫不复的深渊一般。

en.t: It was no longer a matter of simple discomfort; it was as though I had fallen into an abyss from which there was no return.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，我仍然对小姐一往情深，坚信不疑。

en.t: Even so, I remained deeply devoted to the young lady and trusted her without doubt.

units.source_text: 我在相信与怀疑之间一筹莫展，

en.t: Between belief and suspicion, I was utterly at a loss,

units.source_text: 我觉得这两者都是自己的想象，又都是真实的。

en.t: and I felt that both were products of my own imagination, yet both were also real.
